items.title: Build the twenty-seven missing handoff archives

slices.statement: Every completed or deferred v0.8 item is mapped to the commit that closed it, checked rather than assumed
Each archive is built from its own commit in a disposable worktree and verified byte-identical to that commit's tree
Each archive is copied to the evidence directory and verified byte-identical there

items.title: Record the backfill honestly, and say what it is

slices.statement: A committed manifest names every archive with its commit, size, entries, hash, and whether it was retroactive
The handoff document's snapshot table covers every v0.8 item rather than the first four

items.title: Seal a reserve volume, and extend the outer catalog

slices.statement: A new volume seals the backfilled archives, signed by the production subkey and RFC 3161 timestamped
slices.blocked_on: the signing passphrase is unavailable in this session, and seal-content cannot seal a second volume; see performance/v0.8e/VOLUME_PLAN.json

slices.statement: The outer catalog is extended and the reserve verifier passes end to end

items.title: Make a missing archive fail rather than pass unnoticed

slices.statement: make validate fails when a completed plan item has no manifest entry
